business_problem: Facing the challenges of a growing business Nagarro has gone from about 8000 employees to over 18,000 in the last three years.
solution_summary: Nagarro, a Software / SaaS organization in India, modernized this data lake / data warehouse modernization workload with Power BI, Microsoft Teams, Power Automate, Azure AI Bot Service, and Azure AI Services. Facing the challenges of a growing business Nagarro has gone from about 8000 employees to over 18,000 in the last three years. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics so business users can act on fresher insights. Microsoft Teams acts as the collaboration surface where users consume insights, copilots, and workflow updates. Power Automate automates approvals, notifications, and multi-step business workflows across systems. Data from operational systems is ingested into Power BI, processed across Microsoft Teams, and surfaced through Power Automate so teams can act on fresher operational insight. Nagarro increases efficiency by integrating worldwide employees, systems, and data with Microsoft Cloud solutions.
